public_message: Hey, we can offload 180 tonnes at Rs.900 per tonne and we’ll handle the transport – let’s get this rolling!
private_reasoning: Opening at our ask of Rs.900/t to signal value and cover transport costs; our true floor is Rs.550/t so we have wiggle room if needed, but we want to start high to test buyer's flexibility. Logistics are cheap (6km) so offering seller_delivers is easy and keeps the loop moving. Need a quick deal due to 3‑day move rule.
